description: This file defines the Note class for a note-taking application, with fields for title, body, timestamps, tags, and color. It uses Hive for local storage persistence and annotations for Hive type and field IDs. It includes an update method to modify note properties and update timestamps.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A data model representing a note with various fields and an update method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Note's properties such as title, body, tag, and colorValue, and refreshes the updatedAt timestamp.
